heading: Today, Thanksgiving
text: Increasing clouds. Rain developing south late.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Rain, with freezing rain over higher elevations, Quebec, and Orange and Coos Counties north.

heading: Friday
text: Clouds, a few showers. Rain south late.

heading: Saturday
text: Mostly cloudy. A few rain or snow showers north and mountains.
temperature: Upper 30s to upper 40s north to south
